title: leucas calostachys var. schweinfurthii
intro: Leucas calostachys var. schweinfurthii, commonly known as African lavender grass, is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of L. calostachys var. schweinfurthii include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
